QR SLOP · free, in your browser

Make a vCard QR code for your contact details

Print it on a business card, a badge or a slide: anyone who scans it can save your name, number, email and website to their contacts in one tap.

Make a contact QR code

How to do it

  1. The Contact (vCard) form is open. Fill in your name, organisation and job title.
  2. Add your phone, email, website and, if you like, your address.
  3. Style it in the Design tab and add a logo if you want.
  4. Download an SVG for the print shop, or a PNG for screens.

Your files stay on this device: QR SLOP runs in your browser, with no upload, no account and no watermark.

Questions

What happens when someone scans it?

The phone shows the contact and offers to add it to the address book, with every field you filled in.

Can I change my details later?

Only by making a new code. The details are stored in the code itself, not on a server.

Why is the code so dense?

Every field adds data. Leave out fields you do not need, such as the address, for a simpler code that scans more easily when printed small.
